editorial:
Imagine a world where the highways are like wild battlefields and the law doesn't really matter. You get to follow a man who is fueled by pure rage after a crazy driver kills his brother. He doesn't go to the police; instead, he builds a beast of a pickup truck and turns himself into a one-man army on wheels. It feels like a gritty road trip from hell where the main goal is to hunt down anyone who thinks they can drink and drive or bully others on the road. The vibe is dark and tense, making you feel the heat of the asphalt and the roar of the engines.

You will probably love the raw energy and the car chases, though some parts feel a bit slow because it was made for TV back in the day. The acting is solid and feels real, even if the special effects are a bit dated. If you enjoy old-school action that doesn't hold back, you should definitely give this a shot. Since it is an older gem, try to find it on a high-quality stream or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see those car crashes in the best light possible.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the vigilante finally catches up to the motorist who ruined his life. After a brutal car chase and a violent fight, the hero manages to defeat his enemy. He gets the revenge he wanted for his brother, but it leaves him feeling empty. The movie ends with him still on the road, showing that while the bad guy is gone, his life is forever changed by the violence.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s action and revenge stories.
